title: Space Base Mars — Opening Titles
look: warm retro-sitcom film grade, gently saturated 1990s broadcast television look, soft key lighting, subtle film grain, cheerful

dana.description: Commander Dana Vosh, a weary woman in her late 50s with a neat silver bob and tired eyes, wearing a slightly-too-tight navy colony command uniform with a mission patch, standing in a cramped command office, warm sitcom studio lighting, photorealistic character portrait

krill.description: Doctor Favius Krill, chief science officer in his 40s with wild frizzy grey hair and safety goggles pushed up on his forehead, wearing a scorched white lab coat, manic delighted grin, holding a smoking beaker, bright science lab, photorealistic character portrait

bex.description: Bex Okafor, a station engineer in her 30s with braided hair and a deadpan expression, wearing a grease-streaked orange jumpsuit and a heavy tool belt with a roll of duct tape, arms crossed, industrial airlock behind her, photorealistic character portrait

hollis.description: Hollis Pemberton, a gangly geologist with thick glasses and an earnest delighted smile, wearing a knitted cardigan under a hi-vis vest, gently cradling a red Mars rock like a baby, shelves of labelled rock samples behind, photorealistic character portrait

zane.description: Zane Cruz, a vain comms and content officer in his 20s with styled hair and a bright influencer smile, wearing a sleek EVA suit with a small ring-light rig clipped to the chest, striking a selfie pose, photorealistic character portrait

arlo.description: ARLO, an obsolete boxy retro-futurist maintenance android with a single flickering amber eye and a faded corporate logo on its chest panel, holding a mop, slightly hunched passive-aggressive posture, dim station corridor, photorealistic character

shots.prompt: @dana sits at a cluttered command desk stacked with unread reports and a dead potted plant, giving a weary salute to camera, warm sitcom lighting
shots.motion: Dana leans back in her chair with a tired sigh and the dead plant slowly tips over off the desk

shots.prompt: @krill grins with delight in a bright science lab as a beaker erupts in green smoke in front of him
shots.motion: the beaker overflows with green foam and Krill throws his arms up laughing as smoke fills the frame

shots.prompt: @bex stands deadpan in an industrial corridor duct-taping a sparking wall panel
shots.motion: the panel showers sparks across her face and she doesn't flinch, calmly smoothing down another strip of duct tape

shots.prompt: @hollis stands in an office lined with labelled rock samples, hugging a glowing red Mars rock to his chest with a joyful smile
shots.motion: Hollis spins around happily cradling the rock and beams at the camera

shots.prompt: @zane in a sleek EVA suit takes a selfie on the red Martian surface with a vast crater vista behind him
shots.motion: Zane strikes a pose and gives a thumbs up to the camera, then stumbles backward over a rock

shots.prompt: @arlo the obsolete android mops the floor of a dim station corridor, its single amber eye flickering
shots.motion: slow push in as Arlo's eye sparks, it pauses mopping and turns its head to the camera with a weary electronic sigh
